**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The document contains no non-compete or field-of-use restriction binding Northwind. On the contrary, §12.3 is an affirmative freedom-of-operation clause in our favour, and the only competitive restraint (§12.4) binds Brightline. §13.4's licence restrictions are standard use limits (no reverse engineering of hosted source code, no security bypass), not restraints on our business, products, or suppliers. This sits at the rule's preferred position.
